title: Osiris: The First Mummy
subtitle: Murdered, dismembered, reassembled — Egypt's dead king who keeps coming back

What does Osiris's return mean for the dead?

ani.excerpt: Glory be to Osiris Un-Nefer, the great god who dwelleth in Abydos, king of eternity, lord of everlastingness, whose existence endureth for millions of years. Eldest son of the womb of Nut,[1] begotten by Keb,[2] the Erpat,[3] lord of the crowns of the South and North, lord of the lofty white crown, prince of gods and men: he hath received the sceptre, and the whip, and the rank of his divine fathers. Let thy heart in Semt-Ament[4] be content, for thy son Horus is established on thy throne.

narrativeBlocks.title: The good king
narrativeBlocks.body: Osiris rules Egypt as a civilizing king — he teaches agriculture and law. His brother Set, jealous, tricks him into a coffin 'to see if it fits', seals it, and throws it in the Nile.

narrativeBlocks.title: Cut to pieces
narrativeBlocks.body: When Isis finally recovers the body, Set steals it back and dismembers Osiris — scattering the parts across Egypt so he can never be whole. The ultimate erasure.

narrativeBlocks.title: Isis reassembles him
narrativeBlocks.body: Isis searches the land and gathers every piece — and with her magic reassembles Osiris and revives him long enough to conceive their son Horus. The first resurrection in world myth.

narrativeBlocks.title: King of the dead
narrativeBlocks.body: Osiris doesn't return to earthly kingship — he becomes king of the UNDERWORLD, lord of the dead. His murder is transformed into an office: he who was dismembered now welcomes every dismembered-by-time Egyptian.

narrativeBlocks.title: Why every Egyptian wanted this story
narrativeBlocks.body: Osiris's pattern — death, dismemberment, reassembly, life again — is what every dead person hopes to repeat. That is why mummification exists: you make the body whole so the Osiris-story can repeat in you.

quiz.prompt: What does Set do to Osiris?

choices.text: Traps him in a coffin, then dismembers the body and scatters the pieces across Egypt

quiz.explanation: The dismemberment is the point — only Isis's reassembly can undo it.

quiz.prompt: What does Osiris become after death?

choices.text: King of the underworld — the dead pharaoh and lord of the dead, the pattern every Egyptian hoped to follow
He rules the sky as sun
He becomes a serpent of the Nile

quiz.explanation: His story is the promise: death is not the end if the pieces are gathered.
